about: Measurements scripts/scorecard.ts cannot take itself. Record only what was actually measured, with its date and commit; never an estimate. realityCases: real projects with a documented outcome (study conclusion, operator record or official closure notice; never news alone), entered as the client would have entered them before the outcome was known; outcome 'go' = built and running on its own economics or a study advised building, 'no' = abandoned or closed, or a study advised against; reason 'economics' only when the source says so. web is written by `npm run scorecard -- --web <url>`.

web.tool: Lighthouse 12.8.2, mobile (slow 4G, 4× CPU), simulated and applied (DevTools) throttling, local production build
